podcast.body: This song is from a super rare 4-track cassette recorded in 1986 by On a Friday, the band that would later become Radiohead, when they were still teenagers. "So pre-radiohead radiohead, then known as Anna Friday, with a song called Girl in the Purple Dress."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
